asked.item: Am I in the wrong place (Plugins > MCPs > Add MCP server)?
Form asks for a command to launch and arguments

verdict.reason: The setup page describes the ChatGPT desktop app form, including that it opens on STDIO and must be switched to Streamable HTTP with the URL.

steps.text: You are in the right place: in the ChatGPT desktop app, open Plugins, then MCPs, then click Add, then Add MCP server.
The form opens on STDIO, which is why it asks for a command, so select Streamable HTTP instead.
Under Headers, set blotato-api-key to your full API key, and leave Bearer token env var blank.
Then save and restart the MCP connection or client.
